How It Works

From Vision to Bloom

Planning your event should be as enjoyable as the celebration itself. Here's how we make it happen.

01

Inquire

Fill out our booking form with your event details, date, and vision. We'll get back to you within 24 hours.

02

Consult

We'll chat about your dream event — themes, colors, vibe, and budget. This is where the magic starts.

03

Design

We create a custom design proposal tailored to your celebration. You'll see the vision come to life before event day.

04

Bloom

On the day, we handle all the setup and styling. You just show up and enjoy every beautiful moment.

Questions?

Frequently Asked

Everything you need to know before booking your celebration.

What areas do you serve?

+

We're a mobile event styling company serving the Inland Empire, Orange County, and LA County. We come to you and transform any space — homes, parks, venues, restaurants, you name it!

How far in advance should I book?

+

We recommend booking 4-6 weeks in advance to ensure availability, especially for weekend events. However, we do our best to accommodate last-minute requests when our schedule allows!

What's included in your styling packages?

+

Each package is customized to your event, but typically includes a design consultation, full setup and styling on event day, themed decor and props, table and backdrop styling, and complete breakdown/cleanup after the event. We'll discuss all the details during your consultation.

Do you provide food, cake, or entertainment?

+

We focus on event styling and decor design. We don't provide catering, cakes, or entertainment, but we work closely with amazing local vendors and are happy to recommend our trusted partners for those services!

How does pricing work?

+

Every event is unique, so our pricing depends on the type of event, guest count, theme complexity, and your vision. After our initial consultation, we'll provide a detailed custom quote. A deposit is required to secure your date.

Can I customize my theme or colors?

+

Absolutely! That's what we're here for. Whether you have a Pinterest board full of inspiration or just a vague vibe in mind, we'll work with you to create a design that's uniquely yours. No cookie-cutter events here!

What's your cancellation policy?

+

We understand plans can change. Cancellations made 2+ weeks before the event date will receive a partial refund. Details are provided during booking. We're always happy to reschedule when possible.
